Purpose: Bind recurring components across pages so coding agents can implement reusable UI primitives.

left_navigation_sidebar.ReuseGuidance: Implement as a stable shell component when multiple pages share it.

top_header_stats_bar.CanonicalRole: Page-level header, search/actions, and KPI summary

projects_grid_cards.CanonicalRole: Reusable project discovery and launch surface

analytics_sidebar_panels.CanonicalRole: Right-side status, activity, and usage analytics stack

BindingRules: If the same visual/behavioral component appears on multiple pages, keep the same component slug.
If the same component changes layout by viewport, use responsive variants, not a new component name.
If a component changes purpose, create a new component slug even if it looks similar.
